mechanism: Both agents can impair renal function; zoledronic acid causes nephrotoxicity and piperacillin-tazobactam requires renal clearance, increasing accumulation risk and potential for acute kidney injury.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and renal function closely; ensure adequate hydration; adjust piperacillin-tazobactam dosing if renal function declines; consider alternative antibiotics if significant renal impairment develops.
